topic: Cycle-count relaxations require same-trajectory product work and resource closure
mechanism: A per-request accepted-count trace separates current useful output, fixed-duration capacity relaxation and constructed refill schedules. They are distinct from legal arrival, compulsory preparation, shared-resource costs and whole-product critical path.
environment: Frozen 8x910B3 DP1xTP8 DSpark7 48x32K->1024 c12. Run287 and Run239 are separate instrumented diagnostic 48-request trajectories; Run99 is accepted repeated formal Current.
observed: Run287 fixed-duration 1011/1015 cycles are capacity relaxations and zero-cost FIFO1118/1122 are constructed schedules. Run239 measured48 has all8 exact accepted-count parity, 1195 cycles, 49152 useful outputs, observed fixed-duration capacity relaxations1046 fixed-cohort and1045 arbitrary refill, plus one post-useful-output Host-mirror cycle per cohort. Run99 Current571.681tok/s with1217/1212/1206 cycles.
failure_or_limit: Neither Run287 nor Run239 cycle arithmetic includes future real arrival, prefix-conditioned prefill, DSpark seed, KV/state, resource contention, changed acceptance, cycle latency or client publication. 512 is only current zero-output handoff cardinality; HCCL isolated service and FULL Graph current bytes are not compulsory hardware floors. No finite Product TPS upper endpoint is defensible yet.
revalidate_when: Use one correlated formal request/cycle/rank ledger containing arrival, prefix/residual work, full seed-ready, accepted useful outputs, Target/DSpark and HCCL readiness/service/join, state lifetime and publication; measure concurrent attainable compute/HBM/HCCL capacity before promoting a numerical bound or refill gain.
extreme_relation: Calibrates Algorithm/Resource, Hardware, Scheduling/Execution and Product Bound semantics. Highest-priority uncertainty is full same-trajectory work and resource-constrained DAG, not the next isolated kernel.
